# directus_flow (Resource)

Manages a Directus flow (directus_flows).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the flow.

### Optional

- `accountability` (String) Accountability tracking scope (all or activity).
- `color` (String) Accent color (hex) for the flow.
- `description` (String) Description of the flow.
- `icon` (String) Material icon name for the flow.
- `options` (String) Trigger-specific options as a JSON object.
- `status` (String) Flow status (active or inactive).
- `trigger` (String) Trigger type (manual, webhook, schedule, event, operation).

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) Timestamp when the flow was created.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned flow UUID.
- `operation` (String) UUID of the flow's first operation.
- `user_created` (String) UUID of the user who created the flow.
